description: This file implements the QuicConnectionId class and a hasher for connection IDs used in the QUIC protocol, including methods for creation, comparison, hashing, and string conversion.

classes.name: QuicConnectionIdHasher
classes.description: A hasher class for generating stable hash values for connection IDs within a process lifetime.

methods.name: QuicConnectionId::QuicConnectionId()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing an empty connection ID.

methods.name: QuicConnectionId::QuicConnectionId(const char* data, uint8_t length)
methods.description: Constructor initializing connection ID with provided data and length.

methods.name: QuicConnectionId::QuicConnectionId(const absl::Span<const uint8_t> data)
methods.description: Constructor from a span of bytes.

methods.name: QuicConnectionId::~QuicConnectionId()
methods.description: Destructor freeing allocated memory if necessary.

methods.name: QuicConnectionId::operator=(const QuicConnectionId& other)
methods.description: Assignment operator copying data from another connection ID.

methods.name: QuicConnectionId::data()
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the connection ID data.

methods.name: QuicConnectionId::mutable_data()
methods.description: Returns a mutable pointer to the connection ID data.

methods.name: QuicConnectionId::length()
methods.description: Returns the length of the connection ID.

methods.name: QuicConnectionId::set_length(uint8_t length)
methods.description: Sets the length of the connection ID, resizing internal storage as needed.

methods.name: QuicConnectionId::IsEmpty()
methods.description: Checks if the connection ID is empty.

methods.name: QuicConnectionId::Hash()
methods.description: Returns a hash value for the connection ID.

methods.name: QuicConnectionId::ToString()
methods.description: Converts the connection ID to a hex string.
